name: Serina
source: A curious young man named Kousaka Naoto is studying folklore at university. One day in July, just before a long summer vacation, he receives a letter from his missing mentor. Intrigued by the contents of the letter, Naoto decides to visit the infamous Kamimori village as part of his fieldwork. The village is located deep in the mountains and can only be reached by a bus that runs once a day. On the bus, Naoto meets a beautiful girl named Suou Serina, who was born in Kamimori but left the village as a child due to a certain incident. Serina and Naoto stay at the Suou residence, and as they spend more time together, their relationship gradually grows closer.
translation: 好奇心旺盛的青年高坂直人正在大学研究民俗学。7月的一天，漫长暑假即将开始，他收到失踪导师寄来的一封信。信中内容勾起他的兴趣，直人决定将探访恶名远扬的神守村作为田野调查。村庄位于深山之中，每天只有一班公交车能够抵达。车上，直人遇见名叫周防濑里奈的美丽女孩。她出生于神守村，却因某场事件在儿时离开故乡。濑里奈与直人一同住进周防家，随着相处时间增加，两人的关系也逐渐亲密。
